assertions: The response routes the request to the ase-ase-calculators sub-skill (backend selection), not to a workflow sub-skill.
The response compares the GPAW adapter prerequisites (mode PW/LCAO/FD, XC, k-point policy) and the MACE adapter prerequisites (model checkpoint/path, device cpu/cuda, precision).
The response makes a recommendation or asks one focused clarification question when the backend is ambiguous, per the calculators router policy.
The response returns a calculator configuration summary and lists unresolved backend prerequisites.
The response keeps backend configuration separate from workflow-level logic.
The response does not point the user into the original atomistic-workflows source checkout.
